section_summary.extract_value: This section describes procedures for the current (unnamed) study conducted within a wider Portuguese research project. Participants were recruited via private Facebook messages using exponential non-discriminative snowball sampling and completed self-report measures online (10–15 minutes). After data cleaning (excluding males and participants under 18 or over 55), the final analytic sample comprised 369 female participants.
section_summary.evidence_source: The current study is part of a wider Portuguese research about the impact  of emotional experiences and emotion regulation processes in the psychological  functioning and mental health. Participants were  collected through private messages on Facebook and were asked to share it with two more friends (Exponential Non-Discriminative Snowball Sampling method). However, according to the  aims of this study, only 369 participants were selected, resulting in an all females  sample.
